title: Kenyan Fatty Bake
description: A rich and savory Kenyan-inspired bake made with fatty ingredients, perfect for keto diets. This dish is a twist on traditional Kenyan cuisine, with a unique blend of flavors.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together eggs, salt, and black pepper.
Add keto and kenyan to the bowl and whisk until well combined.
Add butter and fatty to the bowl and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Pour the batter into a greased 9x13-inch baking dish.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown and the center is set.
Remove from oven and let cool for 5 minutes before serving.
